assignee.description: Optional assignees. When omitted, the project's configured defaultAssignee applies; pass an empty array to leave the task unassigned.

definitionOfDoneAdd.description: Task-specific Definition of Done items to append for this task only. Do not copy project defaults here.

disableDefinitionOfDoneDefaults.description: Disable project-level Definition of Done defaults for this task creation. Use definition_of_done_defaults_upsert to change project defaults.

documentation.description: Documentation URLs or file paths for understanding this task

dueDate.description: Optional task due date. Use a date such as 2026-08-10. A due date names a day and carries no time.

finalSummary.description: Final summary for PR-style completion notes. Write this only when the task is complete.

modifiedFiles.description: Project-root-relative file paths modified by this task

ordinal.description: Optional non-negative ordering value for manual task ordering. Lower values sort earlier. Prefer spaced integers such as 1000, 2000, 3000 to leave room for inserts.

parentTaskId.description: Existing parent task ID for a subtask. Do not pass milestone IDs here; use milestone instead.

priority.description: Optional task priority (case-insensitive). Valid values: High, Medium, Low

references.description: Reference URLs or file paths related to this task

status.description: Status value (case-insensitive). Valid values: Draft, To Do, In Progress, Done

type.description: Optional task type (case-insensitive). Valid values: bug, feature, enhancement, task, chore, docs, spike
